chain.prompt: A polished Thoughtloom desktop application screen, edge to edge at 1536 × 1024, crisp readable text, no browser or device frame. Moment two of the same inquiry, not an alternative interface. Use the reference only for its shared visual grammar and stable placements: horizontal Search notes/Capture header, unchanged original-source band, large shared thinking area, attached bottom composer. Preserve the flat Night/Parchment, purposeful Lantern/Horizon and Source Sans 3 throughout; never import a note-manager sidebar. The source band still quotes ‘Maybe AI agents should be allowed to disagree before committing to a design.’ with ‘Original input · Unchanged’ and Open source. The inquiry trail links Original thought and Disagreement in review. Main question: ‘When does disagreement improve a decision?’ Within the central thinking area—not a side panel—show ‘More disagreement may improve the design’ attributed ‘AI interpretation · Tentative’. Attach the user’s challenge directly to that claim: ‘The real issue isn’t orchestration; it’s preserving intent across context boundaries.’ Mark ‘You challenged this interpretation’. The challenge visibly opens two possible offshoots, not chronological chat bubbles: ‘What needs to survive a handoff?’ and ‘Who owns the final decision?’ Each is ‘AI proposal · Tentative’, with a short reason and a link to the source/challenge or Decision ownership connection. The first reason: ‘Your challenge shifts attention from review volume to continuity of intent.’ A concise selected relationship ‘Depends on · Decision ownership’ remains inspectable. The ordinary composer is attached to the active question and selected offshoot: ‘Explore intent preservation and decision ownership…’, with Continue inquiry. Include Open discussion history and ‘Illustrative notes · Sources stay unchanged’. Dialogue creates visible thinking branches rather than being buried in a transcript. No giant decorative nodes, map, folders, gradients, glow, shadows, serif, logo or invented dates.

Edit this unapproved second Thoughtloom screen with only three text corrections so the user’s challenge has an explicit target. In the central ‘AI interpretation · Tentative’ box, replace ‘More disagreement may improve the design’ with ‘Better orchestration may make disagreement useful.’ Replace its explanatory paragraph with ‘Coordinating when agents challenge and resolve differences may improve a design.’ In the first AI offshoot ‘What needs to survive a handoff?’, replace its reason with ‘Your challenge shifts attention from orchestration to continuity of intent.’ Preserve the user's exact challenge ‘The real issue isn’t orchestration; it’s preserving intent across context boundaries.’ Preserve every other word, all labels, unchanged-original-source quote, source links, two-offshoot structure, dependency connection, inquiry trail, history link, top header, bottom composer, colors, geometry, controls and type. Do not change the original input or convert tentative AI reasoning into a user claim or established fact. Keep the source and AI distinctions, flat Night/Parchment with Lantern/Horizon, and Source Sans 3-style sans. No new panels, chat bubbles, note-manager sidebar, extra ornament, gradients, shadows, fabricated dates, logos or browser/device frame. Remain a direct 1536 × 1024 screen. This is one narrative correction, not a redesign or an alternative product.

brand.adaptation: Night/Parchment framing, purposeful Lantern/Horizon and Source Sans 3-inspired task type; no logo/emblem/artwork/font copied. Generated pixels approximate the reference.

limitations: The branch diagram is compact in this example; long exchanges and many offshoots need later progressive disclosure and a nonspatial reading path.
The revised interpretation wording is illustrative; speculative claims are not empirical findings. Exact text editing, input behavior and keyboard navigation are not validated.
